description: Declaration and Nomination Form submitted by a new employee at the time of joining. It registers the employee under EPFO and assigns nominees.

fields.name: Name of Establishment
fields.description: Enter the full registered name of the company/factory you have joined.

fields.name: Address of Establishment
fields.description: Complete postal address of the company including PIN code.

fields.name: Name of Employee
fields.description: Your full name as recorded in your ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name if unmarried, or husband's name if married.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format as per official records.

fields.name: Marital Status
fields.description: Married / Unmarried — important for nominee type selection.

fields.name: Date of Joining
fields.description: The date on which you joined this establishment.

fields.name: Nominee Name
fields.description: Full name of the person you are nominating for PF benefits.

fields.name: Nominee Relationship
fields.description: Relationship of the nominee to you (e.g., Wife, Son, Daughter, Mother).

fields.name: Nominee Date of Birth
fields.description: Date of birth of the nominee in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Share Percentage
fields.description: Percentage of PF to be given to this nominee (must total 100% if multiple nominees).

fields.name: Guardian (if nominee is minor)
fields.description: If the nominee is below 18, enter the name and address of the guardian.

fields.name: Employee Signature / Thumb Impression
fields.description: Sign or affix left thumb impression at the bottom of the declaration.
